raj_infra: Heads-up — planning a staggered cohort handoff for the az2 GPU hostpool next Tue 02:00-06:00 UTC. We need to apply a small GPU microcode update + NIC firmware patch. This requires soft reboots and a brief drain per rack. Expect transient capacity drop ~6-8% *during* each cohort.

emma_ops: How many cohorts and what's the per-cohort window? Any ETA on total impact to running jobs? :thinking_face:

raj_infra: 6 cohorts total. Each cohort = drain (~3-5m), soft reboot (~8-10m), post-checks + warmback (~7-10m). We’re scheduling cohorts every 30m so overlap is minimal and pool-level availability stays >90%. Typical job backfill delay should be ~10-15m per affected Pod.

leila_sre: Will this touch Dedicated/reserved pools or only flex/ondemand? We need to ensure SLAs aren’t violated.

raj_infra: Only flex/ondemand pools. Dedicated pools are explicitly excluded. We’ll also spin up temporary preemptible backfill to absorb scheduling churn during warmback. Canary will be 2 racks in eu-west2 first.

emma_ops: Can we do a synthetic load on canary racks before and after to validate perf? Also request KV/prefix cache warmback guidance — some latency-sensitive routes rely on warm cache.

raj_infra: Yes — running synthetic load (qps + token patterns) for 10m pre and post-canary. Cache plan: take a prioritized prefix list and rehydrate top 100 keys during warmback. Simple script below:

```
# warm prefix cache (example)
for p in $(cat top_prefixes.txt); do
  curl -s -X POST https://cache.internal/warm -d "prefix=$p" || echo "warm fail $p"
done
```

tomas_pm: We need a customer comms blurb and calendar invite. Can someone draft a short notice with expected window, impacted pools, and mitigation? Also list contact for urgent rollbacks.

emma_ops: I'll draft a banner and release notes. Add ops-oncall and infra-oncall as contacts. Suggest adding an opt-in for teams that want to move long-running jobs to another region.

leila_sre: Rollback plan? If boot cycles fail or we see degradation after microcode, what's path?

raj_infra: Rollback plan: revert boot config to previous boot image, reapply old microcode via orchestration, and stop cohort rollout. Manual intervention required for racks that fail to come back. Oncall steps documented in runbook. We will also keep a spare rack capacity in us-east to absorb urgent traffic if cross-region routing needed.

opsbot: [automated] Maintenance created: "az2 cohort handoff — gpu microcode + nic firmware" — start Tue 02:00 UTC. Link: https://redwood.internal/maint/1757778888 :calendar:

emma_ops: Can we add a routing fallback policy to prefer eu-west2 for active sessions during the maintenance? Even if cost rises, it avoids tail latency spikes.

raj_infra: Agreed. We'll apply a short-lived routing policy: prefer eu-west2 then us-east1, fallback to az2-only as last resort. Policy TTL = maintenance window + 1h.

leila_sre: One more ask — please capture post-maint metrics: p99 latency, backfill token/sec, instance reboot failures. Add an eval run comparing model outputs pre/post for the canary buckets.

raj_infra: Will do. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/infra/cohort-handoff-az2. I've added owners and rollback checklist.

emma_ops: Thanks — scheduling calendar now and will push customer banner tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
thread_text_summary: Staggered cohort maintenance in az2 to apply GPU microcode + NIC firmware; 6 cohorts, canary in eu-west2, only affects flex pools, excluded Dedicated. Includes warmback, cache rehydration, routing fallback, rollback plan, runbook link, opsbot notification, metrics to capture.
